items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And then we had Steve Lewis. On piano. Yes. Steve Lewis was on piano. Johnny Dodds on clarinet, and Mud Carey on the cornet... That's what Mud told me. Only four pieces that you came up.

ctx.x: Well he passed as Joe Oliver's nephew. That's the same call then I'm thinking. Yeah, that little cornet player, little trumpet player, he was just learning then. I never knew him.
Well Lewis called him uncle too. Oh yes.
But Nelson was supposed to be his nephew.
